chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Mu'alla Abu Uthman, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'I hear a sneeze while I am in prayer, so should I praise Allah and send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)?' He said, 'Yes. And when your brother sneezes and you are in prayer, say, 'The praise is for Allah,' and send blessings upon the Prophet. And if there is estrangement between you and your companion, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.'
ai.seo_question: What should a Muslim say when they hear someone sneeze while they are praying?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes that responding to a sneeze with 'Alhamdulillah' and sending blessings upon the Prophet (saying 'Sallallahu Alayhi wa Aalihi') is a recommended act (mustahabb) that does not invalidate the prayer, even if done silently or mentally. It highlights the continuity of devotional etiquette during worship, emphasizing that the connection to the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt remains active regardless of physical distance or social estrangement, reinforcing the Shia practice of invoking blessings upon the Prophet's family specifically.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Moalla Abu Usman, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to himasws, ‘I hear the sneeze while I am in the Salāt, so should I Praise Allahazwj and send Blesings upon the Prophetsaww?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. And when your brother sneezes and you are in the Salāt, so say, ‘The Praise is for Allahazwj, and Blessings be upon the Prophetsaww’; and if there was unhappiness between you and your companions, send Blessings upon Muhammadsaww and hissaww Progenyasws’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Mu‘alla’ abu ‘Uthman from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘In Salah (prayer) I hear sneezing, can I then praise Allah and say, “O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause?” 5 He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, when your brother (in belief) sneezes while you are in Salah (prayer) say, “All praise belongs to Allah. O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause; even if there is an ocean between you and your friend, say, ‘O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.” 5 ”
